ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of MsCorSvc.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "mscorsvc.dll". Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\mscorsvc\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
